source: Selected DSH attempts, Upstream59 V4 Pro normal, local dsh-stream.jsonl
line_unit: 1-based nonempty stream event; tool calls deduplicated per trial by callId
pairing: For each policy rejection, first later completed read of normalized path, then first later completed native edit/write of that path. Distinct rejections can share a subsequent event.
payload_equality: Exact tool name and content/old_string/new_string/replace_all keys and values; ignores unrelated tool metadata.
todo_completion: Self-reported progress. Association across self-selected cohorts is descriptive.
